title: Binance Futures Will Launch SOLUSD COIN-M Quarterly and Bi-Quarterly Contracts with up to 20x Leverage
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region.  Fellow Binancians, Binance Futures will launch the  SOLUSD CM 0927  Quarterly and  SOLUSD CM 1227  Bi-Quarterly Contracts at  2024-08-14 12:00 (UTC) and 2024-08-14 12:05 (UTC) ,   with up to 20x leverage.  More details on the SOLUSD COIN-M Quarterly and Bi-Quarterly Contracts can be found in the table below:   COIN-M Delivery Contract SOLUSD CM 0927 SOLUSD CM 1227 Launch Time 2024-08-14 12:00 (UTC)  2024-08-14 12:05 (UTC)  Underlying Asset Solana (SOL) Settlement Asset SOL Tick Size 0.001 Maximum Leverage 20x Trading Hours 24/7 Multi-Assets Mode Not Supported Please Note:  Based on market risk conditions, Binance may adjust the specifications of the aforementioned futures contract(s) from time to time, which include the tick size, maximum leverage, initial margin, and/or maintenance margin requirements. The SOLUSD COIN-M Quarterly and Bi-Quarterly Contracts are subject to the terms of the  Binance Terms of Use  and the  Binance Futures Service Agreement . There may be discrepancies in the translated version of this original article in English. Please reference this original version for the latest or most accurate information where any discrepancies may arise. Binance Team 2024-08-08 Note: This announcement was updated on 2024-08-14 to clarify the contract type is COIN-M Delivery Contract. It was previously updated on 2024-08-10 to clarify there is no funding fee charge for the SOLUSD COIN-M Quarterly and Bi-Quarterly Contracts.
